record.body:
## Problem

The product is still named se-workflow everywhere (plugin id, Python package, CLI bin, docs). The intended name is agent-affidavit with CLI `aff`. Keeping the old name confuses installs, PATH, and branding once this leaves dogfood.

## Approach

Not yet scoped. Direction: rename the shippable surfaces (plugin, package, CLI, docs) to agent-affidavit / `aff`. Decide how far the rename reaches (contract project id, git remotes, compatibility shims) at discuss.

## Exit criteria

Not yet scoped. Decide at plan-phase after discuss settles the approach.
record.subject: rename-agent-affidavit
